class.name: YAML
class.brief_description: Utility class for parsing and generating YAML.
class.description:
Provides static methods to parse YAML text into Godot [Variant]s and to convert [Variant]s back into YAML strings. [codeblock] var data = YAML.parse_string(""" name: Player health: 100 inventory: - Sword - Shield """) print(data.name) # "Player" print(data.inventory[0]) # "Sword"
var yaml_text = YAML.stringify(data) print(yaml_text) [/codeblock] On parse errors the methods return [code]null[/code] and print an error message (they do not crash the engine).

method.name: parse_string
parse_file
method.description: Loads a YAML file from [param path] and parses its contents. Equivalent to [code]YAML.parse_string(FileAccess.get_file_as_string(path))[/code]. Returns [code]null[/code] if the file cannot be opened or the content is invalid YAML.

method.name: stringify
method.description: Converts a [Variant] into a YAML-formatted string. Supported types: [code]null[/code], [bool], [int], [float], [String], [Dictionary] and [Array] (and nested combinations of these). Other types are converted to their string representation. [codeblock] var data = { "name": "Player", "stats": [10, 20, 30] } print(YAML.stringify(data)) # name: Player # stats: # - 10 # - 20 # - 30 [/codeblock]
